# Objetivo

Este notebook estima una sensibilidad MNL donde las variables sociodemográficas se
asocian a la residencia inferida del usuario (`zona_hogar`) y no a la zona de
origen del viaje. La separación conceptual es:

- variables sociodemográficas e ingreso proxy: `res_*`, medidas en `zona_hogar`;
- oferta, demanda, OSM operacional, macrozonas y atributos de viaje: origen/contexto
  del viaje;
- `BIP` se mantiene como alternativa base para variables comunes.

El notebook no reemplaza al notebook 16. Estima dos contrastes sobre la muestra
con residencia de confianza alta:

- especificación intermedia `B`: sociodemografía medida en `zona_inicio_viaje`;
- especificación residencial `C`: sociodemografía medida en `zona_hogar`.

Esto permite separar el efecto de filtrar a usuarios con residencia confiable del
efecto de cambiar la unidad territorial de las variables sociodemográficas.

## 3) Helpers

```{python}
#| label: helpers
print("label: helpers")
def unique_ordered(items: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    return list(dict.fromkeys(items))


def biogeme_iter_candidates(model_name: str, project_root: Path) -> list[Path]:
    return [
        project_root / f"{model_name}.iter",
        project_root / f"__{model_name}.iter",
        project_root / "03_models" / f"{model_name}.iter",
        project_root / "03_models" / f"__{model_name}.iter",
        Path.cwd() / f"{model_name}.iter",
        Path.cwd() / f"__{model_name}.iter",
    ]


def remove_biogeme_iter_file(model_name: str, project_root: Path) -> None:
    seen = set()
    for iter_path in biogeme_iter_candidates(model_name, project_root):
        if iter_path in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(iter_path)
        if iter_path.exists():
            iter_path.unlink()


def result_artifact_dir(model_label: str) -> Path:
    out_dir = RESULTS_DIR / model_label
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return out_dir


def stats_to_frame(stats: dict) -> pd.DataFrame:
    return pd.DataFrame(
        [
            {"metric": key, "value": val[0] if isinstance(val, tuple) else val}
            for key, val in stats.items()
        ]
    )


def metric_value(stats: dict, metric: str):
    value = stats.get(metric)
    if isinstance(value, tuple):
        return value[0]
    return value


def param_value(params_df: pd.DataFrame, name: str, candidates: list[str]):
    for col in candidates:
        if col in params_df.columns:
            subset = params_df.loc[params_df["Name"] == name, col]
            if not subset.empty:
                return subset.iloc[0]
    return None


def parse_yaml_diagnostics(yaml_path: Path) -> dict:
    if not yaml_path.exists():
        return {}
    with yaml_path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        payload = yaml.safe_load(fh) or {}
    opt = payload.get("optimization_messages", {}) or {}
    return {
        "yaml_convergence": payload.get("convergence"),
        "yaml_relative_gradient": opt.get("Relative gradient"),
        "yaml_cause_of_termination": opt.get("Cause of termination"),
        "yaml_algorithm": opt.get("Algorithm"),
        "yaml_n_iterations": opt.get("Number of iterations"),
        "yaml_n_grad_evals": opt.get("Number of gradient evaluations"),
        "yaml_n_hessian_evals": opt.get("Number of hessian evaluations"),
    }


def configure_biogeme_run(biogeme_model: bio.BIOGEME) -> None:
    biogeme_model.biogeme_parameters.set_value("generate_html", False)
    biogeme_model.biogeme_parameters.set_value("generate_yaml", False)
    biogeme_model.biogeme_parameters.set_value("save_iterations", BIOGEME_OPTIMIZER["save_iterations"])
    biogeme_model.biogeme_parameters.set_value("number_of_threads", 1)
    biogeme_model.biogeme_parameters.set_value(
        "calculating_second_derivatives",
        BIOGEME_OPTIMIZER["calculating_second_derivatives"],
    )
    biogeme_model.biogeme_parameters.set_value(
        "optimization_algorithm",
        BIOGEME_OPTIMIZER["optimization_algorithm"],
    )


def load_numeric_df(path: Path, extra_cols: list[str]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    cols = unique_ordered(BASE_MODEL_COLUMNS + extra_cols)
    lazy_df = pl.scan_parquet(path)
    schema_names = lazy_df.collect_schema().names()
    missing = sorted(set(cols) - set(schema_names))
    if missing:
        raise ValueError(f"Faltan columnas requeridas en {path.name}: {missing}")
    null_summary = (
        lazy_df
        .select([pl.col(c).is_null().sum().alias(c) for c in cols])
        .collect()
        .to_dicts()[0]
    )
    missing_nulls = {c: n for c, n in null_summary.items() if n}
    if missing_nulls:
        raise ValueError(f"Columnas requeridas con nulos en {path.name}: {missing_nulls}")
    return (
        lazy_df
        .select([pl.col(c).cast(pl.Float64) for c in cols])
        .collect()
        .to_pandas()
    )
```

## 4) Materializar muestras filtradas

```{python}
#| label: prepare-filtered-samples
print("label: prepare-filtered-samples")
if not RESIDENCE_SAMPLE_PATH.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(
        "No existe la muestra residencial. Ejecuta primero: "
        f"`python scripts/audits/build_residence_model_sample.py --sample-tag {ESTIMATION_SAMPLE_TAG}`"
    )

lf_residence = pl.scan_parquet(RESIDENCE_SAMPLE_PATH)
# El MNL declara disponibles BIP, QR_RED y QR_OTHER para cada observación.
# Si falta un atributo de alguna alternativa, se excluye la observación en vez
# de imputar cero, porque cero tendría significado de espera/tiempo nulo.
lf_residence_complete = lf_residence.filter(
    pl.all_horizontal([pl.col(c).is_not_null() for c in TRIP_ALT_ATTR_COLS])
)
n_residence_total = pl.scan_parquet(RESIDENCE_SAMPLE_PATH).select(pl.len()).collect().item()
n_residence_complete = lf_residence_complete.select(pl.len()).collect().item()
n_residence_incomplete = n_residence_total - n_residence_complete
if n_residence_incomplete:
    print(
        f"ℹ️ Excluyendo {n_residence_incomplete:,} filas con atributos alternativa incompletos "
        f"({n_residence_incomplete / n_residence_total:.4%} de la muestra residencial). "
        "Reconstruye con "
        f"`python scripts/audits/build_residence_model_sample.py --sample-tag {ESTIMATION_SAMPLE_TAG} --force` "
        "si el conteo es inesperado."
    )

sample_specs = [
    ("home_alta", HOME_ALTA_SAMPLE_PATH, pl.col("home_confidence") == "alta"),
    ("home_alta_media", HOME_ALTA_MEDIA_SAMPLE_PATH, pl.col("home_confidence").is_in(["alta", "media"])),
]

sample_summary_rows = []
for label, path, filter_expr in sample_specs:
    df_sample = lf_residence_complete.filter(filter_expr).collect()
    if df_sample.is_empty():
        raise ValueError(f"La muestra filtrada {label} quedó vacía")
    df_sample.write_parquet(path, compression="zstd")
    n_cards = df_sample.select(pl.col("id_tarjeta").n_unique()).item()
    choice_counts = (
        df_sample
        .group_by("choice_nested")
        .agg(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n_rows"),
                pl.col("res_censo_zone_imputed").fill_null(0).sum().alias("n_res_censo_zone_imputed"),
                pl.col("res_eod_zone_imputed").fill_null(0).sum().alias("n_res_eod_zone_imputed"),
            ]
        )
        .with_columns((pl.col("n_rows") / pl.col("n_rows").sum()).alias("share"))
        .sort("choice_nested")
    )
    for row in choice_counts.to_dicts():
        sample_summary_rows.append(
            {
                "sample": label,
                "sample_path": path.name,
                "choice_nested": row["choice_nested"],
                "n_rows": row["n_rows"],
                "share": row["share"],
                "n_total_rows": df_sample.height,
                "n_cards": n_cards,
                "n_res_censo_zone_imputed": row["n_res_censo_zone_imputed"],
                "n_res_eod_zone_imputed": row["n_res_eod_zone_imputed"],
            }
        )

df_sample_summary = pl.DataFrame(sample_summary_rows)
with pl.Config(tbl_rows=-1, tbl_cols=-1, tbl_width_chars=1400):
    display(df_sample_summary)
```

## 6) Modelo MNL

```{python}
#| label: mnl-helper
print("label: mnl-helper")
def estimate_mnl_with_extras(
    pandas_df: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    model_name: str,
    extra_cols: list[str],
    param_tags: dict[str, str],
):
    database = db.Database(model_name, pandas_df)

    CHOICE_BIP = 0
    CHOICE_QR_RED = 1
    CHOICE_QR_OTHER = 2

    CHOICE = Variable("choice_nested")
    LAB_PM = Variable("DUMMY_LAB_PM")
    LAB_PT = Variable("DUMMY_LAB_PT")
    NO_LAB = Variable("DUMMY_NO_LAB")
    DUMMY_ANIO_2025 = Variable("DUMMY_ANIO_2025")
    LOG_DEMAND = Variable("LOG_N_VIAJES_ZONA_INICIO_FRANJA")
    LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY = Variable("LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY")
    LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT = Variable("LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT")
    LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT = Variable("LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT")

    TVH_BIP = Variable("TVH_BIP")
    TVH_QR_RED = Variable("TVH_QR_RED")
    TVH_QR_OTHER = Variable("TVH_QR_OTHER")
    TEI_BIP = Variable("TEI_BIP")
    TEI_QR_RED = Variable("TEI_QR_RED")
    TEI_QR_OTHER = Variable("TEI_QR_OTHER")
    TET_BIP = Variable("TET_BIP")
    TET_QR_RED = Variable("TET_QR_RED")
    TET_QR_OTHER = Variable("TET_QR_OTHER")
    NTR_BIP = Variable("NTR_BIP")
    NTR_QR_RED = Variable("NTR_QR_RED")
    NTR_QR_OTHER = Variable("NTR_QR_OTHER")

    def beta(name: str, default: float = 0.0):
        return Beta(name, default, None, None, 0)

    ASC_QR_RED = beta(f"ASC_QR_RED_{MODEL_PARTITION}")
    ASC_QR_OTHER = beta(f"ASC_QR_OTHER_{MODEL_PARTITION}")
    B_QR_RED_LAB_PM = beta(f"B_QR_RED_LAB_PM_{MODEL_PARTITION}")
    B_QR_OTHER_LAB_PM = beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_LAB_PM_{MODEL_PARTITION}")
    B_QR_RED_LAB_PT = beta(f"B_QR_RED_LAB_PT_{MODEL_PARTITION}")
    B_QR_OTHER_LAB_PT = beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_LAB_PT_{MODEL_PARTITION}")
    B_QR_RED_NO_LAB = beta(f"B_QR_RED_NO_LAB_{MODEL_PARTITION}")
    B_QR_OTHER_NO_LAB = beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_NO_LAB_{MODEL_PARTITION}")
    B_QR_RED_ANIO_2025 = beta(f"B_QR_RED_ANIO_2025_{MODEL_PARTITION}")
    B_QR_OTHER_ANIO_2025 = beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_ANIO_2025_{MODEL_PARTITION}")
    B_QR_RED_LOG_DEMAND = beta(f"B_QR_RED_LOG_DEMAND_{MODEL_PARTITION}")
    B_QR_OTHER_LOG_DEMAND = beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_LOG_DEMAND_{MODEL_PARTITION}")
    B_QR_RED_LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY = beta(f"B_QR_RED_LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY_{MODEL_PARTITION}")
    B_QR_OTHER_LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY = beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY_{MODEL_PARTITION}")
    B_QR_RED_LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT = beta(f"B_QR_RED_LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT_{MODEL_PARTITION}")
    B_QR_OTHER_LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT = beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT_{MODEL_PARTITION}")
    B_QR_RED_LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT = beta(f"B_QR_RED_LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT_{MODEL_PARTITION}")
    B_QR_OTHER_LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT = beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT_{MODEL_PARTITION}")

    B_BIP_T_VEH = beta(f"B_BIP_T_VEH_{MODEL_PARTITION}")
    B_QR_RED_T_VEH = beta(f"B_QR_RED_T_VEH_{MODEL_PARTITION}")
    B_QR_OTHER_T_VEH = beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_T_VEH_{MODEL_PARTITION}")
    B_BIP_T_ESPERA_INI = beta(f"B_BIP_T_ESPERA_INI_{MODEL_PARTITION}")
    B_QR_RED_T_ESPERA_INI = beta(f"B_QR_RED_T_ESPERA_INI_{MODEL_PARTITION}")
    B_QR_OTHER_T_ESPERA_INI = beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_T_ESPERA_INI_{MODEL_PARTITION}")
    B_BIP_T_ESPERA_TRASB = beta(f"B_BIP_T_ESPERA_TRASB_{MODEL_PARTITION}")
    B_QR_RED_T_ESPERA_TRASB = beta(f"B_QR_RED_T_ESPERA_TRASB_{MODEL_PARTITION}")
    B_QR_OTHER_T_ESPERA_TRASB = beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_T_ESPERA_TRASB_{MODEL_PARTITION}")
    B_BIP_N_TRASB = beta(f"B_BIP_N_TRASB_{MODEL_PARTITION}")
    B_QR_RED_N_TRASB = beta(f"B_QR_RED_N_TRASB_{MODEL_PARTITION}")
    B_QR_OTHER_N_TRASB = beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_N_TRASB_{MODEL_PARTITION}")

    extra_var_exprs = {c: Variable(c) for c in extra_cols}
    extra_betas_red = {
        c: beta(f"B_QR_RED_{param_tags[c]}_{MODEL_PARTITION}")
        for c in extra_cols
    }
    extra_betas_other = {
        c: beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_{param_tags[c]}_{MODEL_PARTITION}")
        for c in extra_cols
    }

    V_BIP = (
        B_BIP_T_VEH * TVH_BIP
        + B_BIP_T_ESPERA_INI * TEI_BIP
        + B_BIP_T_ESPERA_TRASB * TET_BIP
        + B_BIP_N_TRASB * NTR_BIP
    )

    V_QR_RED = (
        ASC_QR_RED
        + B_QR_RED_LAB_PM * LAB_PM
        + B_QR_RED_LAB_PT * LAB_PT
        + B_QR_RED_NO_LAB * NO_LAB
        + B_QR_RED_ANIO_2025 * DUMMY_ANIO_2025
        + B_QR_RED_LOG_DEMAND * LOG_DEMAND
        + B_QR_RED_LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY * LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY
        + B_QR_RED_LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT * LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT
        + B_QR_RED_LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT * LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT
        + B_QR_RED_T_VEH * TVH_QR_RED
        + B_QR_RED_T_ESPERA_INI * TEI_QR_RED
        + B_QR_RED_T_ESPERA_TRASB * TET_QR_RED
        + B_QR_RED_N_TRASB * NTR_QR_RED
    )

    V_QR_OTHER = (
        ASC_QR_OTHER
        + B_QR_OTHER_LAB_PM * LAB_PM
        + B_QR_OTHER_LAB_PT * LAB_PT
        + B_QR_OTHER_NO_LAB * NO_LAB
        + B_QR_OTHER_ANIO_2025 * DUMMY_ANIO_2025
        + B_QR_OTHER_LOG_DEMAND * LOG_DEMAND
        + B_QR_OTHER_LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY * LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY
        + B_QR_OTHER_LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT * LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT
        + B_QR_OTHER_LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT * LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT
        + B_QR_OTHER_T_VEH * TVH_QR_OTHER
        + B_QR_OTHER_T_ESPERA_INI * TEI_QR_OTHER
        + B_QR_OTHER_T_ESPERA_TRASB * TET_QR_OTHER
        + B_QR_OTHER_N_TRASB * NTR_QR_OTHER
    )

    for c in extra_cols:
        V_QR_RED += extra_betas_red[c] * extra_var_exprs[c]
        V_QR_OTHER += extra_betas_other[c] * extra_var_exprs[c]

    V = {CHOICE_BIP: V_BIP, CHOICE_QR_RED: V_QR_RED, CHOICE_QR_OTHER: V_QR_OTHER}
    av = {CHOICE_BIP: 1, CHOICE_QR_RED: 1, CHOICE_QR_OTHER: 1}
    logprob = models.loglogit(V, av, CHOICE)

    if BIOGEME_OPTIMIZER["clean_iter_before_run"]:
        remove_biogeme_iter_file(model_name, PROJECT_ROOT)
    biogeme = bio.BIOGEME(database, logprob)
    biogeme.model_name = model_name
    configure_biogeme_run(biogeme)

    results = biogeme.estimate()
    stats = results.get_general_statistics()
    params_df = br.get_pandas_estimated_parameters(results)
    return results, stats, params_df
```

## 7) Helpers de parámetros

```{python}
#| label: parameter-helpers
print("label: parameter-helpers")
def new_variable_parameter_rows(
    *,
    params_df: pd.DataFrame,
    model_label: str,
    block: str,
    extra_cols: list[str],
    param_tags: dict[str, str],
):
    rows = []
    for col in extra_cols:
        tag = param_tags[col]
        for alternative, prefix in [
            ("BIP", "B_BIP"),
            ("QR_RED", "B_QR_RED"),
            ("QR_OTHER", "B_QR_OTHER"),
        ]:
            param_name = f"{prefix}_{tag}_{MODEL_PARTITION}"
            if alternative == "BIP":
                rows.append(
                    {
                        "model": model_label,
                        "family": "mnl",
                        "block": block,
                        "variable": col,
                        "alternative": alternative,
                        "parameter": f"{param_name} [normalized]",
                        "beta": 0.0,
                        "robust_t": None,
                        "robust_p": None,
                    }
                )
                continue
            rows.append(
                {
                    "model": model_label,
                    "family": "mnl",
                    "block": block,
                    "variable": col,
                    "alternative": alternative,
                    "parameter": param_name,
                    "beta": param_value(params_df, param_name, ["Value"]),
                    "robust_t": param_value(params_df, param_name, ["Robust t-stat.", "Rob. t-test", "t-test"]),
                    "robust_p": param_value(params_df, param_name, ["Robust p-value", "Rob. p-value", "p-value"]),
                }
            )
    return rows


def base_model_parameter_rows(*, params_df: pd.DataFrame, model_label: str, block: str):
    param_specs = [
        ("ASC", "QR_RED", "ASC_QR_RED"),
        ("ASC", "QR_OTHER", "ASC_QR_OTHER"),
        ("LAB_PM", "QR_RED", "B_QR_RED_LAB_PM"),
        ("LAB_PM", "QR_OTHER", "B_QR_OTHER_LAB_PM"),
        ("LAB_PT", "QR_RED", "B_QR_RED_LAB_PT"),
        ("LAB_PT", "QR_OTHER", "B_QR_OTHER_LAB_PT"),
        ("NO_LAB", "QR_RED", "B_QR_RED_NO_LAB"),
        ("NO_LAB", "QR_OTHER", "B_QR_OTHER_NO_LAB"),
        ("ANIO_2025", "QR_RED", "B_QR_RED_ANIO_2025"),
        ("ANIO_2025", "QR_OTHER", "B_QR_OTHER_ANIO_2025"),
        ("LOG_DEMAND", "QR_RED", "B_QR_RED_LOG_DEMAND"),
        ("LOG_DEMAND", "QR_OTHER", "B_QR_OTHER_LOG_DEMAND"),
        ("LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY", "QR_RED", "B_QR_RED_LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY"),
        ("LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY", "QR_OTHER", "B_QR_OTHER_LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY"),
        ("LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT", "QR_RED", "B_QR_RED_LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT"),
        ("LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT", "QR_OTHER", "B_QR_OTHER_LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT"),
        ("LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT", "QR_RED", "B_QR_RED_LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT"),
        ("LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT", "QR_OTHER", "B_QR_OTHER_LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT"),
        ("T_VEH", "BIP", "B_BIP_T_VEH"),
        ("T_VEH", "QR_RED", "B_QR_RED_T_VEH"),
        ("T_VEH", "QR_OTHER", "B_QR_OTHER_T_VEH"),
        ("T_ESPERA_INI", "BIP", "B_BIP_T_ESPERA_INI"),
        ("T_ESPERA_INI", "QR_RED", "B_QR_RED_T_ESPERA_INI"),
        ("T_ESPERA_INI", "QR_OTHER", "B_QR_OTHER_T_ESPERA_INI"),
        ("T_ESPERA_TRASB", "BIP", "B_BIP_T_ESPERA_TRASB"),
        ("T_ESPERA_TRASB", "QR_RED", "B_QR_RED_T_ESPERA_TRASB"),
        ("T_ESPERA_TRASB", "QR_OTHER", "B_QR_OTHER_T_ESPERA_TRASB"),
        ("N_TRASB", "BIP", "B_BIP_N_TRASB"),
        ("N_TRASB", "QR_RED", "B_QR_RED_N_TRASB"),
        ("N_TRASB", "QR_OTHER", "B_QR_OTHER_N_TRASB"),
    ]
    rows = []
    for variable, alternative, param_prefix in param_specs:
        param_name = f"{param_prefix}_{MODEL_PARTITION}"
        rows.append(
            {
                "model": model_label,
                "family": "mnl",
                "block": block,
                "variable": variable,
                "alternative": alternative,
                "parameter": param_name,
                "beta": param_value(params_df, param_name, ["Value"]),
                "robust_t": param_value(params_df, param_name, ["Robust t-stat.", "Rob. t-test", "t-test"]),
                "robust_p": param_value(params_df, param_name, ["Robust p-value", "Rob. p-value", "p-value"]),
            }
        )
    return rows
```

## 8) Ejecutar estimación

```{python}
#| label: run-estimation
print("label: run-estimation")
summary_rows = []
parameter_rows = []
base_parameter_rows = []

if RUN_ESTIMATION:
    for spec in MODEL_SPECS:
        if ESTIMATE_ONLY_LABELS and spec["label"] not in ESTIMATE_ONLY_LABELS:
            print(f"Saltando estimación, se intentará cargar desde disco: {spec['label']}")
            continue
        pandas_df = load_numeric_df(spec["sample_path"], spec["extra_cols"])
        sample_size_for_error = len(pandas_df)
        out_dir = result_artifact_dir(spec["label"])
        params_path = out_dir / f"params_{spec['label']}.csv"
        stats_path = out_dir / f"stats_{spec['label']}.csv"
        yaml_path = out_dir / f"{spec['label']}.yaml"

        print(f"Estimando: {spec['label']} ({sample_size_for_error:,} filas)")
        try:
            results, stats, params_df = estimate_mnl_with_extras(
                pandas_df,
                model_name=spec["label"],
                extra_cols=spec["extra_cols"],
                param_tags=spec["param_tags"],
            )
            params_df.to_csv(params_path, index=False)
            stats_to_frame(stats).to_csv(stats_path, index=False)
            results.dump_yaml_file(str(yaml_path))
            yaml_diag = parse_yaml_diagnostics(yaml_path)
            run_converged = yaml_diag.get("yaml_convergence") is True

            summary_rows.append(
                {
                    "family": spec["family"],
                    "block": spec["block"],
                    "model": spec["label"],
                    "sample": spec["sample"],
                    "sample_path": spec["sample_path"].name,
                    "n_extra_vars": len(spec["extra_cols"]),
                    "n_params": metric_value(stats, "Number of estimated parameters"),
                    "sample_size": metric_value(stats, "Sample size"),
                    "ll_init": metric_value(stats, "Init log likelihood"),
                    "ll_final": metric_value(stats, "Final log likelihood"),
                    "aic": metric_value(stats, "Akaike Information Criterion"),
                    "bic": metric_value(stats, "Bayesian Information Criterion"),
                    "gradient_norm": metric_value(stats, "Final gradient norm"),
                    "status": "ok" if run_converged else "not_converged",
                    "error_type": None,
                    "error_message": None,
                    **yaml_diag,
                }
            )
            if run_converged:
                parameter_rows.extend(
                    new_variable_parameter_rows(
                        params_df=params_df,
                        model_label=spec["label"],
                        block=spec["block"],
                        extra_cols=spec["extra_cols"],
                        param_tags=spec["param_tags"],
                    )
                )
            else:
                print(f"⚠️ {spec['label']} no convergió; parámetros excluidos de tablas wide")
            base_parameter_rows.extend(
                base_model_parameter_rows(
                    params_df=params_df,
                    model_label=spec["label"],
                    block=spec["block"],
                )
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            print(f"ERROR en {spec['label']}: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
            summary_rows.append(
                {
                    "family": spec["family"],
                    "block": spec["block"],
                    "model": spec["label"],
                    "sample": spec["sample"],
                    "sample_path": spec["sample_path"].name,
                    "n_extra_vars": len(spec["extra_cols"]),
                    "n_params": None,
                    "sample_size": sample_size_for_error,
                    "ll_init": None,
                    "ll_final": None,
                    "aic": None,
                    "bic": None,
                    "gradient_norm": None,
                    "status": "error",
                    "error_type": type(exc).__name__,
                    "error_message": str(exc),
                    "yaml_convergence": None,
                    "yaml_relative_gradient": None,
                    "yaml_cause_of_termination": None,
                    "yaml_algorithm": None,
                    "yaml_n_iterations": None,
                    "yaml_n_grad_evals": None,
                    "yaml_n_hessian_evals": None,
                }
            )
            (out_dir / f"{spec['label']}.error.txt").write_text(
                "".join(traceback.format_exception(type(exc), exc, exc.__traceback__)),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

        del pandas_df
        gc.collect()

    print(
        "Estimaciones ejecutadas en memoria. "
        "Los CSV agregados se escriben en la celda `load-results`, "
        "después de cargar modelos existentes desde disco."
    )
else:
    print("RUN_ESTIMATION = False. No se ejecutaron estimaciones.")
```

## 9) Cargar resultados desde disco

```{python}
#| label: load-results
print("label: load-results")
loaded_models = []
missing_models = []
models_already_in_memory = {row["model"] for row in summary_rows}

for spec in MODEL_SPECS:
    if spec["label"] in models_already_in_memory:
        continue
    out_dir = result_artifact_dir(spec["label"])
    params_path = out_dir / f"params_{spec['label']}.csv"
    stats_path = out_dir / f"stats_{spec['label']}.csv"
    yaml_path = out_dir / f"{spec['label']}.yaml"
    if not (params_path.exists() and stats_path.exists() and yaml_path.exists()):
        missing_models.append(spec["label"])
        continue
    params_df = pd.read_csv(params_path)
    stats_df = pd.read_csv(stats_path)
    stats = dict(zip(stats_df["metric"], stats_df["value"]))
    yaml_diag = parse_yaml_diagnostics(yaml_path)
    run_converged = yaml_diag.get("yaml_convergence") is True
    summary_rows.append(
        {
            "family": spec["family"],
            "block": spec["block"],
            "model": spec["label"],
            "sample": spec["sample"],
            "sample_path": spec["sample_path"].name,
            "n_extra_vars": len(spec["extra_cols"]),
            "n_params": metric_value(stats, "Number of estimated parameters"),
            "sample_size": metric_value(stats, "Sample size"),
            "ll_init": metric_value(stats, "Init log likelihood"),
            "ll_final": metric_value(stats, "Final log likelihood"),
            "aic": metric_value(stats, "Akaike Information Criterion"),
            "bic": metric_value(stats, "Bayesian Information Criterion"),
            "gradient_norm": metric_value(stats, "Final gradient norm"),
            "status": "loaded_ok" if run_converged else "loaded_not_converged",
            "error_type": None,
            "error_message": None,
            **yaml_diag,
        }
    )
    if run_converged:
        parameter_rows.extend(
            new_variable_parameter_rows(
                params_df=params_df,
                model_label=spec["label"],
                block=spec["block"],
                extra_cols=spec["extra_cols"],
                param_tags=spec["param_tags"],
            )
        )
    base_parameter_rows.extend(
        base_model_parameter_rows(
            params_df=params_df,
            model_label=spec["label"],
            block=spec["block"],
        )
    )
    loaded_models.append(spec["label"])

print(f"Modelos cargados desde disco: {len(loaded_models)}")
if missing_models:
    print(f"Modelos sin artefactos completos: {missing_models}")

if summary_rows:
    pd.DataFrame(summary_rows).to_csv(RESULTS_DIR / "convergence_summary.csv", index=False)
if parameter_rows:
    pd.DataFrame(parameter_rows).to_csv(RESULTS_DIR / "new_variable_parameters_long.csv", index=False)
if base_parameter_rows:
    pd.DataFrame(base_parameter_rows).to_csv(RESULTS_DIR / "base_parameters_long.csv", index=False)
```

## 11) Parámetros de variables nuevas — formato horizontal

```{python}
#| label: new-variable-parameters-wide
print("label: new-variable-parameters-wide")
if parameter_rows:
    df_params_pd = pd.DataFrame(parameter_rows)
    df_wide = df_params_pd.pivot_table(
        index=["block", "family", "model", "variable"],
        columns="alternative",
        values=["beta", "robust_t", "robust_p"],
        aggfunc="first",
    )
    df_wide.columns = [
        f"{metric}_{alt.lower()}"
        for metric, alt in df_wide.columns.to_flat_index()
    ]
    df_wide = (
        df_wide
        .reset_index()
        .rename(
            columns={
                "robust_t_bip": "t_bip",
                "robust_p_bip": "p_error_bip",
                "robust_t_qr_red": "t_qr_red",
                "robust_p_qr_red": "p_error_qr_red",
                "robust_t_qr_other": "t_qr_other",
                "robust_p_qr_other": "p_error_qr_other",
            }
        )
        .sort_values(["block", "family", "model", "variable"], kind="stable")
    )
    with pl.Config(tbl_rows=-1, tbl_cols=-1, tbl_width_chars=2200):
        display(pl.from_pandas(df_wide))
else:
    print("No hay parámetros de variables nuevas.")
```
